groups.name: Muscle-conscious active GLP-1 users
groups.description: People on Mounjaro/Zepbound/Wegovy who already work out (gym, Peloton, running) and are alarmed that their lifts, stamina and lean mass are dropping along with the fat.

groups.name: New starters figuring out GLP-1 nutrition
groups.description: People in their first months on Zepbound or semaglutide who suddenly need to eat enough protein, fiber and water rather than eat less, and feel left alone to work it out.

groups.name: Data-driven self-trackers
groups.description: Organized, numbers-minded GLP-1 users who log doses, side effects, weight and macros, often out of pocket, and want one place to see patterns and show their doctor.

groups.name: Maintainers and tapering users
groups.description: People who have reached or are near goal and are tapering or stopping the medication, and fear returning hunger and weight regain.
